Message from Flo 🩸: If you want the safest “set it and forget it” option, Leakproof underwear is a great first pick—it has a built-in liner that can absorb about 1–17 tsp (about 1–14 regular tampons) and can help with sweat, discharge, spotting, periods, or light bladder leaks. Essential underwear is best if you just want everyday underwear with a quick-dry liner and no leakproof protection.
